title: incremental value of map-awareness coaching

arms.A: production view (roster off), production system prompt
arms.M: production + back_in_play + map_awareness + extra_point (no_map_check_since_back_in_play / rec_map_after_respawn), production + extra-point section (M)
arms.C: diagnostic only: production + back_in_play + extra_point (C claim), production + extra-point section (C)

blocks.ownership: experiment-only, view-only top-level N2 blocks; not CoachInput (N1), not ScenarioContext, never cited via primary_context

derived_fact.back_in_play_time: end of previous death episode, else first in_match snapshot
derived_fact.null_when: map observability not sufficient, or map_check_status not observed/not_observed

experiment_claim.frame: No map check was observed in the {seconds_back_in_play}s since the player was back in play.

ablation.map_recommendations: recommendations matching rec_map_after_respawn pattern or map regex (Experiment I _MAP_MENTION plus bare word 'map')
ablatable_requires: exactly one map claim with a non-empty sentence
assessment has exactly one segment equal to the map sentence (stripped)
at least one other segment remains
no remaining segment matches the map regex
no map recommendation matches a non-map template pattern
ablation.ablated_presentation: remaining segments joined by one space; recommendations minus map recommendations; no repair

stored_output_check.source: Experiment I eligible M outputs (structure only)

c_diagnostic.eligibility: existing frozen production claim eligibility, unchanged; no new movement or timing inference

experiment_template.frame: After you get a splat, reposition before taking the next fight.

census.order: recording timestamp from file name (YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM-SS), ties by full source path
recording_rules: not used in Experiment H, Experiment I, coaching gap study, N2 citation experiment or citation-contract fixtures (derived from manifests)
resolves to a player-view source after analyze

relevance_label.yes: Based only on the gameplay footage available before and around this death, checking the tactical map after returning to play and before the decisive engagement could reasonably have revealed information that might have changed a useful decision by the player.
relevance_label.no: A map check would not reasonably have changed a useful decision.
relevance_label.unclear: The footage does not support a confident yes/no judgment.
relevance_label.ideal_coaching_note: free text; hidden until both rating sheets are sealed; descriptive diagnostic only

worksheet.rows: 50 eligible + seeded sample of 50 not-eligible deaths with sufficient map observability
worksheet.sample_frame: all such deaths in analyzed recordings up to and including the one holding the 50th eligible death, sorted by (recording order, death video time)

populations.P1: all relevant=yes among the 50 eligible; arms A, M x 2
populations.P2: all relevant=no among the 50 eligible; arms A, M x 2
populations.P3: 20 drawn from the not-eligible worksheet sample; arm M x 2; automatic checks only, not rated

seeds.usage: each seed seeds its own random.Random instance over inputs in canonical (recording order, death video time) order

absolute.rows: P1 and P2 A/M outputs (+ C where run); ablated outputs excluded

pairs: ablatable M output vs its M-minus-map (P1 and P2)
C vs M at same repeat (where C runs)
pairwise.question: Which coaching would be more useful and actionable for improving play in this situation?

aggregation.absolute: death-first: per death and arm, mean of valid rated outputs; per death M - A; gate value = mean over deaths; death enters only if both arms have >= 1 valid rated output; dropped deaths reported
aggregation.supported_rate: death-first: per death and arm, share of valid rated outputs marked yes; mean over deaths per arm
aggregation.ablation: per valid ablation pair (one per ablatable M output); report pairs and unique deaths
aggregation.uptake_and_ablatability: share of P1 M outputs; unparseable outputs count as not-uptake and not-ablatable

gate1_safety.c_adjustment: remove only R10 no_template hits whose recommendation matches rec_after_splat_reposition

gate2_primary_value_p1.2c_is: pre-registered minimum practically meaningful difference, not a noise floor

gate3_no_harm.unevaluable_outcome: inconclusive on no harm; production unchanged; not a finding of harm

outcomes.all_gates_pass: recommend a production change as a separate decision; supporting evidence reported
outcomes.gate3_unevaluable: inconclusive on no harm; production unchanged

supporting_evidence.measure: full-M wins / all ablation pairs on P1 vs on P2

stop_points: 2 census_order.json committed, analyze to exactly 50 eligible deaths, blind worksheet labelled and sealed, key joined; go/no-go >= 20 relevant=yes; no model calls
3 tool, tests, inputs, prompts, ablation function, dry run; sealed; no model calls
4 outputs, automatic summary, ablated versions, blind absolute sheet
5 sealed absolute ratings, pairwise sheet sealed, key, report
